The '''Timira City Cloning Facility''' was a highly classified [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility operated by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] inside [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was [[Assault on Kamino|destroyed]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
The Timira City Cloning Facility was established in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. [[Barracks D4]] and [[Barracks D5]] were part of the facility, and a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] detachment was stationed at the facility.<ref name="TFU2" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], the [[Battalion Commander]], ordered all the new recruits to stand trench duty, although he personally considered it a mindless assignment.<ref name="TFU2 databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' Databank</ref>

==History==
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] there.<ref name="TFU2" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFU2 project" /> one of the clones, designated [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|broke out]] and charged through the Facility, damaging it and causing many casualties.<ref name="TFU2" /> Another clone of Marek, [[Subject 1157]], was cloned there under the supervision of a [[Unidentified cloning technician|cloning technician]],<ref name="LucasArtsCite-''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' Official Site">{{LucasArts|url=games/theforceunleashed2|text=''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II''}}</ref> while the [[Lead Cloning Technician]] supervised the whole project.<ref name="TFU2" /> Clones of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] were also grown there.<ref name="TFU2 comic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed 2'' comic]]</ref> The maintenance log recorded several strange instances, such as a reinforced catwalk breaking free, and a work crew fried by an energy substation. Individuals from the [[Imperial Sith Acolyte|Acolyte Program]] seemed to be involved. At one time, the [[Imperial Engineering Corps/Legends|Engineering Corps]] received a shipment of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] for construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] belonging to the [[Saber Guard]] Program.<ref name="TFU2 databank" />

Later, Starkiller returned and led a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] attack against the Facility to rescue [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. He guided the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] to crash onto the facility, disrupting the planetary [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] and allowing the Rebels to attack. After the battle, Darth Vader was captured, and the wrecked [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] were allowed to fall onto the Facility, damaging it.<ref name="TFU2" />
